title: Arbitration clause
ruleSource: Written from S.A Badmus' Professional Ethics and Skills drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base). To be confirmed by the legal reviewer.

parts.why: The title. Source: Professional Ethics drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
In the event of any dispute arising out of or in connection with this agreement between {{partyOne}} and {{partyTwo}}, the parties shall first submit the dispute to arbitration.

The arbitration shall be governed by the {{governingLaw}}.

The arbitration shall be conducted in the English language, by {{arbitrators}} appointed {{appointment}}.

The seat of the arbitration shall be {{seat}}.

The award shall be delivered within {{awardPeriod}} of the appointment of the arbitrators, unless the parties extend the time.
parts.why: The essentials of an arbitration clause: the disputes covered, the governing law, the language, the number of arbitrators and how they are appointed, the seat, and the time for the award. Source: Professional Ethics drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

fields.label: First party
fields.question: Who is the first party, with address?

fields.label: Second party
fields.question: Who is the second party, with address?

fields.label: Governing law
fields.question: Which law governs the arbitration? For example: Arbitration and Mediation Act 2023.

fields.label: Arbitrators
fields.question: How many arbitrators? For example: a sole arbitrator, or three arbitrators.

fields.label: Appointment
fields.question: How are they appointed? For example: by both parties from the Chartered Institute of Arbitrators.

fields.label: Seat
fields.question: Where is the seat of the arbitration?

fields.label: Time for the award
fields.question: Within how long must the award be made? For example: six months.
